period: The recon month in the format YYYYMM.
sku: Stock Keeping Unit - your internal product identifier.
product_title: The product title as shown on the product display page.
average_selling_price: An average of your selling price for the last 3 months.
success_fee: The success fee covers the referral fee, transactional costs, customer support, and platform support.
fulfilment_fee: The fulfilment fee for the product based on the fulfilment fee rate and product dimensions/weight.
total_claim_value: The amount you need to include on your invoice to Takealot to claim for lost stock.
opening_balance: Total qty in all of Takealot's warehouses at the beginning of the period.
shipment_received: Qty received via shipments or is in the process of being received at a Takealot warehouse.
returns_received_into_goodstock: Qty received via returned stock that has been evaluated and put back into buyable stock.
lost_in_transit_returns_found: Qty received back into the Takealot warehouses that were previously thought to be Lost in Transit.
other_inflow: Other increases in the period (e.g. stock found).
total_inflow: Total increase to the qty in Takealot's warehouses during the period.
shipped_to_customer: Qty shipped to customers in the period.
removal_orders_collected: Qty collected by you in the period for good stock removal orders.
removal_orders_disposed: Qty prepared for you for good stock removal orders that has been disposed in the period.
other_outflow: Other decreases in the period (e.g. stock lost).
total_outflow: Total decrease to the qty in Takealot's warehouses during the period.
closing_balance: Total qty in all of Takealot's warehouses at the end of the period.
stock_in_transit: Total qty in transit between Takealot warehouses.
removal_orders_awaiting_collection_or_be: Qty requested and prepared for removal orders submitted or awaiting collection by you.
return_removal_orders_collected: Qty collected by you in the period for bad stock removal orders
returns_removal_order_disposed: Qty prepared for bad stock removal orders that has been disposed in the period.
